muxlTrack.description: A track backed by a MUXL container

blob.description: BLAKE-3 content hash (BDASL CID) of the source video segment.

language.description: Language of the track, if applicable.

mediaType.description: Type of the track: video, audio, or text.

signingKey.description: did:key of the ephemeral key that C2PA-signed this track's segments. The private key is discarded once the track is produced, so it can only ever have signed this content.

size.description: Size in bytes of the source video segment.

trackId.description: ID of the track within the MUXL container. 1-indexed for MP4 reasons.

sourceClip.description: An object representing that this video's source is a clip from another video.

end.description: End time of the clip in milliseconds.

start.description: Start time of the clip in milliseconds.

video.description: AT URI of the video we're clipping.

sourceTracks.description: A collection of tracks representing the canonical source of a video.

tracks.description: The canonical list of tracks specifying the source of a video.
